description: Token autocomplete dropdown with a search input and a results list (icon, name, description, type) plus an optional create-token footer, keyboard-navigable and searching through the token provider. On open, the search input's focus is re-asserted across ~10 animation frames (a same-keystroke render can refocus the block editable), but the loop yields once document.activeElement moves to another real non-editable element — a deliberate Tab/click never gets pulled back (CF18-3).

parameters.name: CurrentKey
parameters.description: Pre-selects the item matching this key when the dropdown opens.

parameters.name: OnClosed
parameters.description: Raised when the user dismisses the dropdown (Escape / backdrop click).

parameters.name: OnCreateRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the user clicks "Create token" (optional). Arg = current search query.

parameters.name: OnItemSelected
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string Key, string DisplayName, string? ColorClass)>
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects a token. Args = (Key, DisplayName, ColorClass).
